_comment: The per-segment digit-prefix rule, including the preserveDigitSuffix divergence: the Model__/Entity__ segment rule keeps a single-char alpha suffix VERBATIM (4o), while the slug rule title-cases it (4O). A curated suffix override wins under BOTH settings.

provenance.ref: curated suffix override under the slug rule

mutation.description: turns preserve OFF, which must not change a curated suffix

provenance.ref: curated suffix override under the segment rule

mutation.description: turns preserve ON, which must not change a curated suffix either

provenance.ref: the Model__/Entity__ segment rule preserves a single-char alpha suffix verbatim

mutation.description: turns preserve ON for an UNCURATED suffix, the half of the divergence that keeps 4o lowercase

provenance.ref: the slug rule title-cases a single-char alpha suffix

mutation.description: flips preserve OFF on the same token, which is the ONLY difference producing 4O

provenance.ref: an all-digit token has no alpha suffix to case
a curated brand as the alpha suffix after a digit prefix

mutation.description: substitutes a curated brand for the single-char suffix
